Review Krea?

Reviewers mostly see Krea as a strong AI image tool for fast generation, upscaling, and creative experiments, with particular praise for Enhance/Upscale, realtime generation, and clean pattern or logo blending. Several users say it works well for banners, covers, and other design tasks, and they like the simple interface and speed. The main tradeoffs are weaker precision for small edits, inconsistent image quality, especially with human figures, and a heavy dependence on strong prompts. A few also report messy gallery organization and poor promotion-related communication.

Review Generated Photos?

Reviewers mostly see Generated Photos as an intuitive, flexible character creator that makes realistic human images quickly, with strong customization for faces, hairstyles, outfits, body types, ages and poses. Several say it works well for practical tasks like visual ads or finding specific book characters, and they like that it needs less prompt fiddling than other generators. The main complaints are image glitches—extra limbs, awkward hands and poses, unreliable accessories and clothing controls, weak face aging—and one reviewer raises concern about misuse of the face-upload feature.
